# android — 2022 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

### CVE-2022-1529
- Assigner: mozilla | Published: 2022-12-22 | Updated: 2025-04-16 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: Untrusted input used in JavaScript object indexing, leading to prototype pollution; CWE-1321 CWE-1321 Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

An attacker could have sent a message to the parent process where the contents were used to double-index into a JavaScript object, leading to prototype pollution and ultimately attacker-controlled JavaScript executing in the privileged parent process. This vulnerability affects Firefox ESR < 91.9.1, Firefox < 100.0.2, Firefox for Android < 100.3.0, and Thunderbird < 91.9.1.

Affected:
- Mozilla / Firefox ESR: affected unspecified <91.9.1 (custom)
- Mozilla / Firefox: affected unspecified <100.0.2 (custom)
- Mozilla / Firefox for Android: affected unspecified <100.3.0 (custom)
- Mozilla / Thunderbird: affected unspecified <91.9.1 (custom)

References:
- https://www.mozilla.org/security/advisories/mfsa2022-19/
- https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1770048

### CVE-2022-1802
- Assigner: mozilla | Published: 2022-12-22 | Updated: 2025-04-16 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: Prototype pollution in Top-Level Await implementation; CWE-1321 CWE-1321 Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

If an attacker was able to corrupt the methods of an Array object in JavaScript via prototype pollution, they could have achieved execution of attacker-controlled JavaScript code in a privileged context. This vulnerability affects Firefox ESR < 91.9.1, Firefox < 100.0.2, Firefox for Android < 100.3.0, and Thunderbird < 91.9.1.

Affected:
- Mozilla / Firefox ESR: affected unspecified <91.9.1 (custom)
- Mozilla / Firefox: affected unspecified <100.0.2 (custom)
- Mozilla / Firefox for Android: affected unspecified <100.3.0 (custom)
- Mozilla / Thunderbird: affected unspecified <91.9.1 (custom)

References:
- https://www.mozilla.org/security/advisories/mfsa2022-19/
- https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1770137

### CVE-2022-22784 — Improper XML Parsing in Zoom Client for Meetings
- Assigner: Zoom | Published: 2022-05-18 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: 8.1
- CWE: Improper Input Validation
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N`

The Zoom Client for Meetings (for Android, iOS, Linux, MacOS, and Windows) before version 5.10.0 failed to properly parse XML stanzas in XMPP messages. This can allow a malicious user to break out of the current XMPP message context and create a new message context to have the receiving users client perform a variety of actions.This issue could be used in a more sophisticated attack to forge XMPP messages from the server.

Affected:
- Zoom Video Communications Inc / Zoom Client for Meetings for Android: affected unspecified <5.10.0 (custom)
- Zoom Video Communications Inc / Zoom Client for Meetings for iOS: affected unspecified <5.10.0 (custom)
- Zoom Video Communications Inc / Zoom Client for Meetings for Linux: affected unspecified <5.10.0 (custom)
- Zoom Video Communications Inc / Zoom Client for Meetings for MacOS: affected unspecified <5.10.0 (custom)
- Zoom Video Communications Inc / Zoom Client for Meetings for Windows: affected unspecified <5.10.0 (custom)

Credits: Ivan Fratric of Google Project Zero
